claim: To raise the cache hit ratio, forward only the query string parameters for which the origin returns unique objects, use the same case and the same order for query string parameters, forward only specified cookies instead of all cookies, and create separate cache behaviors for static and dynamic content so that cookies are forwarded to the origin only for dynamic content.

evidence.quote: Configure CloudFront to forward only the query string parameters for which your origin will return unique objects.
Use the same case (uppercase or lowercase) for all instances of the same parameter.
List parameters in the same order.
Configure CloudFront to forward only specified cookies instead of forwarding all cookies.
Create separate cache behaviors for static and dynamic content, and configure CloudFront to forward cookies to your origin only for dynamic content.
